subject.title: [Bug]: Real-time logs of openclaw cron jobs are not displayed in the chat session of the webui

question: Where should live progress from isolated cron runs be surfaced before the run finishes?
rationale: Current code deliberately scopes cron execution to run-specific sessions and current docs define final delivery or polling, so changing this requires a UX/product choice rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Run-scoped follow chat
options.body: Expose a running cron session link or follow action that opens the run-scoped chat while preserving isolation from the creator or selected chat.

options.title: Mirror into selected chat
options.body: Stream progress into the chat the user was watching, accepting the higher risk of mixing automated cron output with an unrelated session context.

options.title: Keep final-only delivery
options.body: Treat current behavior as intended and improve Cron UI polling/docs so users know to inspect finished run history rather than expect live chat logs.

recommendation.title: Run-scoped follow chat
recommendation.body: Expose a running cron session link or follow action that opens the run-scoped chat while preserving isolation from the creator or selected chat.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest history signal for the isolated cron runner/session split and is the best available owner for the product-boundary decision.
